features.feature: Define an implementable host-discovery architecture for Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and Antigravity CLI (agy).

Separate host entrypoints, .lattice/Lattice.md navigation, operational runbook projection, normative decision documents, and CLI/registry/gate authority with explicit precedence and no duplicated truth.
Keep AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md budgets as anti-regression ceilings, preserve repository-local constraints such as the OMX ban without universalizing them, and avoid inventing CODEX.md or AGY.md.
Explain how Claude receives shared instructions without copying a second long root contract.
Inventory behavior-affecting CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md and canonical-path consumers across audit, docs-drift, reviewers, templates, sync, triggers, managed assets, and verifiers.
Assign every discovered mechanical consumer to an implementation slice or explicitly justify it out of scope.

Specify test-first red/green checks for size budgets, effective constraint reachability, imports, links, anchors, cycles, audit coverage, bounded reviewer reads, process-fact contracts, branding, and command consistency.
Define fail-closed compatibility, staged cutover, rollback points, and recovery for stale links, conflicting commands, failed red tests, and partial template migration.
Provide ordered, independently reviewable implementation Story slices rather than an all-in-one migration.
Choose a single-owner, safe convergence path for B-e514 and prevent overlapping root-file writes or premature old-contract retirement.
Keep operational guidance mechanically checked against registries and normative decisions so the runbook cannot become a third truth source.
Clearly label all runtime/template/verifier/root cutover changes as future implementation work; this Story does not implement them.
features.excluded_by: The Story is documentation-only and CHK-001 explicitly requires proposed implementation to remain future work.

features.feature: Create only the new execution-plan decision document and modify only docs/requirements/NAV.md, leaving unrelated files and B-e514 untouched.
Register exactly one discoverable NAV entry at the exact new decision-document path and describe it as active normative planning authority.
Recompute and update the NAV decision-file count independently, while preserving ordering and avoiding duplicate, case-variant, missing, legacy, retired, or superseded links.
Avoid unrelated NAV authority changes, demotion of existing canonical documents, or wording that makes root entrypoints/runbook co-equal normative sources.
